notes: Strip x 5300-8830 of 22-35N. Clifton Avenue measured between property lines (100 ft printed): west lot line to park/UC line; the extra solid line ~30-40 px inside the west line is not a street line. Lines inside Calhoun and Straight labelled 10"/6" W. PIPE are water mains, not kerbs; their south lines coincide with the plate's clip edge. Clifton/Dixmyth is an acute Y at the very top edge of the plate (+-20 px). Clifton/Calhoun: west leg off plate, recorded T. Woodside Place (printed WOODSIDE ... PLACE, 30 ft) runs along the Burnet Woods east edge and ends at West University Avenue (University continues east as a stub); a separate 30 ft strip printed WOODSIDE PL. runs along the UC east line from y~6210 to the stub at y~6890, written 'Woodside Place (south of University)'. Stub names printed only in part on this plate (inferred from position against the 1904 sheets 259/260/263/265, spacing matches within ~50 px): Woodside stubs at y 3476 and 4160 print 'W.' = West St. Clair Street and West Rochelle Street; stub at y 2797 prints 'R...' and sits where 1904 has Lakewood Avenue, left as '?'; the 'W.' stub at y 6891 = West Corry Street; Calhoun stub '...N AVE.' = West Clifton Avenue, '...RNE' = Hartshorne Street (1904 Hartshorn Street). A narrow (~15 ft) unnamed alley stub enters Calhoun from the south at x~8167. Not recorded (centre outside x 5300): Stratford Avenue / Straight Street T at about (5217, 6730); Stratford ends there, and the 60 ft stub printed '...VE' south of Straight at x 5117-5202 is a different street offset west.
